brief:
The Faculty of Agriculture and Veterinary Medicine at Al-Quds University has introduced a new doctoral program in veterinary medicine, Maan Wire reported. The program represents an expansion of advanced professional training opportunities available to Palestinian students seeking specialized credentials in veterinary science and practice.

The launch comes as Palestinian universities continue developing graduate-level offerings across technical and scientific disciplines. The veterinary doctoral program will operate under the faculty's existing academic framework, building on undergraduate and master's-level instruction in agricultural and veterinary fields that the institution has offered for years.
title: Al-Quds University launches doctoral program in veterinary medicine
